subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Workbook practice: skimming a Fact File and multiple choice
outcomes: Skim a Fact File to find information quickly
Choose the best heading for a text and give reasons

tf.s: The World Trade Organisation deals with the rules of trade between countries.
tf.why: Yes, the WTO deals with trade rules.

tf.s: Oman became a member of the WTO on 9 November 2000.
tf.why: That is the date in the Fact File.

tf.s: In Activity 1 you may write as many words as you like for each answer.
tf.why: The rule is no more than three words.

tf.s: Headings and sub-headings can help you know what information is inside a text.
tf.why: They show how the ideas are organised.

tf.s: Pictures are not helpful when you skim a text.
tf.why: Pictures help you get the gist quickly.

tf.s: You should read the whole text before answering multiple-choice items.
tf.why: Then it is easier to reject the wrong answers.

tf.s: In a multiple-choice item, you usually reject three options to find the right one.
tf.why: Rejecting wrong options helps you find the answer.

tf.s: The best heading relates only to the first sentence of the text.
tf.why: The best heading relates to the whole text.

tf.s: WTO stands for World Travel Organisation.
tf.why: WTO stands for World Trade Organisation.

tf.s: Skimming a Fact File helps you decide if the information you need is there.

boxes.q: What does a Fact File mostly give?
boxes.why: A Fact File organises facts under headings.

hunt.q: Best heading for Al Sumar text

mcq.q: Which organisation deals with the rules of trade between countries?
mcq.why: The WTO deals with trade rules.

mcq.q: How should you mark your answer in a multiple-choice test?
mcq.why: Shading the bubble shows your answer.

mcq.q: What do headings on a Fact File help you do?
mcq.why: Headings show where to find information.

mcq.q: When did Oman become a member of the WTO?
mcq.why: The Fact File gives this exact date.

mcq.q: A question says 'Answer in no more than three words.' Which answer is correct?
o: It was the famous Silk Road route
the long Silk Road of old times
a road for silk and spices trade
mcq.why: Only 'the Silk Road' keeps to three words.

mcq.q: You need to know if a Fact File mentions Oman. What is the fastest way?
mcq.why: Skimming headings tells you quickly if it is there.

mcq.q: How were goods carried in modern times, according to Activity 1?
mcq.why: The answer in Activity 1 is 'by gigantic supertankers'.

mcq.q: Why is it a good idea to read the whole text before multiple-choice items?
o: You get the gist, so rejecting wrong answers is easier
The answers are always in the title
mcq.why: Understanding the whole text helps you choose.

mcq.q: Why is heading c the best for the Farooq Al Sumar text?
o: It relates to the whole text
mcq.why: A good heading fits the whole text, not one part.

mcq.q: Why are pictures and sub-headings useful when skimming?
o: They show the gist and how ideas are organised
They give the answers to every question
mcq.why: They give a quick overview of the text.
